=== Lead photograph (31 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of the right-hand man in a Facebook photograph posted 10 December 2008, captioned "Derek and Jen in front of Burruss". The Facebook photo viewer names Derek Brooks. Exact legal name already on the wiki plus membership in the Star Wars CCG Facebook group (added by Casey Anis on 22 March 2014). Gold 46 Williamsburg, Virginia. The profile lists Lives Williamsburg, Virginia and From Williamsburg, Virginia. The woman on the left is Jen Brooks; dest the crop of Derek. A bronze globe sculpture circular is not the person lead. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Derek Brooks portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Derek Brooks Facebook portrait.jpg]].
